jobs.title: Internship in Variability Visualization Framework for Large-Scale Graphical Languages 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Internship on Power Systems of the Future 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join a dynamic research team shaping the future of energy systems. You will explore how renewable energy, smart grids, and sector coupling are transforming power systems worldwide. This 6 months internship offers a unique chance to contribute to next-generation solutions while developing your skills in a supportive and flexible environment. You'll work closely with experts across business units and gain valuable insights into innovation and sustainability. How you'll make an impact Perform market analysis on renewables and smart grid topics Derive system and product requirements based on the market analysis Define high-level functional architectures for future solutions Simulate future energy scenarios and technologies Model emerging technologies across power system levels (e.g. DC grids, electro-mobility, energy storage, electrolyzes and fuel cells, demand response, etc.) Develop, maintain and document new techno-economic assessment tools for simulating behavior of energy systems on different time scale Build future energy scenarios on regional and global scales Your background Currently pursuing a M.S. degree in electrical engineering or completed a similar M.S. degree less than 12 months ago Familiar with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi) integrated into simulation workflows developed in MATLAB and Python Experience with renewable energy and smart grid technologies, solutions, and concepts, combined with proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, or similar Excellent communicator in English, both in writing and speaking Background in the following power system topics: steady-state and dynamic stability analysis and modeling, fault analysis and power system protection, energy and ancillary service markets Self-starter with a strong willingness to learn, capable of working independently while also being a reliable and collaborative team player More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Procurement Team Lead 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine dynamische und erfahrene Führungskraft für den Einkauf, die unser engagiertes Service-Team bei Hitachi, Ltd. verstärkt, wo Geschwindigkeit und Qualität von größter Bedeutung sind. In dieser Schlüsselposition führen Sie strategische Einkaufsinitiativen, optimieren die Beschaffungsprozesse und leiten ein talentiertes Team von etwa 12 Einkaufsexperten. Ihre Expertise sorgt für eine schnelle und kosteneffiziente Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen, während Sie höchste Qualitätsstandards wahren und langfristige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen zu Lieferanten fördern. Das können Sie bewirken Sie übernehmen die Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Einkaufsteams und gestalten eine leistungsorientierte sowie verantwortungsbewusste Unternehmenskultur. Sie entwickeln und implementieren innovative Beschaffungskonzepte im Einklang mit unserer Service-Strategie. Dabei legen Sie besonderen Wert auf termingerechte Lieferung, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung, Effizienzsteigerung in der Lieferkette und nachhaltige Kostenreduzierung. Die Anwendung der Critical-Path-Methode zur Sicherstellung pünktlicher Beschaffungsprozesse und zur Minimierung von Lieferverzögerungen gehört zu Ihren Kernaufgaben. Sie gewährleisten durchgängige Exzellenz im gesamten Einkaufsprozess – von der Bedarfsermittlung bis zur Zahlung – und sorgen für klare Abläufe sowie maximale Transparenz. Sie definieren und steuern die Lieferanten-Segmentierung und entwickeln zielgerichtete Beschaffungsstrategien. Zudem verantworten Sie die Auswahl, Qualifizierung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit Lieferanten. Durch den Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften auf Führungsebene und die Etablierung robuster Lieferantenmanagement-Systeme mit KPIs, Scorecards, regelmässigen Reviews und Eskalationsprozessen sichern Sie die nachhaltige Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Lieferantennetzwerks. Sie arbeiten eng mit abteilungsübergreifenden Teams wie Materialplanung, Engineering, Qualität und Controlling zusammen, um den Einkauf optimal auf die Unternehmensanforderungen abzustimmen. Sie steuern einkaufsbezogene Risiken, einschließlich Lieferkettenstörungen, Preisschwankungen und Compliance-Themen. Das bringen Sie mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Supply Chain Management, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung. Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Einkauf oder Supply Chain Management oder mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich. Nachweisbare Erfolge im strategischen Einkauf, in Verhandlungen und im Lieferanten- oder Kundenmanagement sind von Vorteil. Sehr gutes Verständnis von Einkaufsprozessen, Vertragsrecht und Prinzipien der Lieferkette. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsvermögen. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Einkauf-Software (z.B. SAP Ariba) und Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel. Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem schnelllebigen, internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten zu managen. Erfahrung in den Bereichen Fertigung, Technologie oder Industrie ist sehr wünschenswert. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungen zu optimieren und schaffen eine Umgebung, in der sich alle Mitarbeitenden weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Service Project & Tender Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency.  In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage contract execution, including documenting and controlling changes and amendments Monitor contract performance, identifying deviations and driving corrective actions where needed Ensure accurate and timely execution of all commercial aspects in close collaboration with technical, financial, and legal stakeholders Support business development by providing expert advice on commercial and contractual topics, leveraging strong legal knowledge Your background Bachelor's degree or technical qualification (FH\/HF\/TS), preferably in electrical engineering, with knowledge of power electronics and\/or control technology Initial professional experience (2–3 years) in projects, tenders, contract management or a technical role with exposure to project or customer-facing work, with the ability to manage tasks independently Strong commercial mindset and interest in contract negotiation, with first exposure to or willingness to develop skills in contract, change, and claim management Basic understanding of legal terminology and contractual frameworks, or motivation to build up this knowledge in a commercial role Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders in a complex environment Hands-on, customer-focused mindset with a strong drive to deliver results Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP SD\/CS preferred) and fluent in German and English More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. Align the BU Transformers methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving LCA\/EPD standards. Apply these methodologies to transformer-relevant materials and decisions by defining measurable requirements for suppliers and by supporting internal stakeholders with actionable guidance for material choices, claims, and customer requests. Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels.

jobs.title: Vorarbeiter/in Elektromontage 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung   Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z.   B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus   Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di manutenzione dell'attrezzatura di spostamento – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur d'entretien de l'équipement de poste – Échéance 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni - Mantenere e ottimizzare l'attrezzatura chimica e al plasma bagnati per garantire elevata disponibilità - Risoluzione dei problemi e sistemi complessi di riparazione in collaborazione con i partner OEM - Pianificare e sostenere attività di manutenzione preventiva per migliorare le prestazioni degli utensili - Gestire i pezzi di ricambio e contribuire agli aggiornamenti delle attrezzature e miglioramenti dei processi - Collaborare con team di ingegneria, R&D e operazioni per sostenere gli obiettivi di produzione - Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica e supportare il monitoraggio dei dati nei sistemi MES - Identificare e implementare miglioramenti in strumenti, processi ed efficienza operativa - Garantire il rispetto degli standard HSE e promuovere un ambiente di lavoro sicuro
• Requisiti - Formazione professionale tecnica nell'automazione, nell'elettronica o in un settore relativo (EFZ o equivalente) - 2+ anni di esperienza nella manutenzione delle attrezzature in semiconduttori o industrie simili - Forte conoscenza tecnica negli strumenti al plasma (ad es. sistemi AMAT, LAM) - Solida comprensione dell'elettronica, meccanica, pneumatica e sistemi di vuoto - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente orientato al team e all'interno delle operazioni a turni - Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese (il tedesco è un plus) Cosa? - Ti unirai a un ambiente di produzione dinamico e veloce in cui il lavoro di squadra, l'affidabilità e l'eccellenza tecnica sono fondamentali. - Lavorando in una configurazione a turni, sarete parte di un team di manutenzione altamente qualificato che supporta operazioni critiche e processi produttivi avanzati. - Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica con tecnologie complesse e l'opportunità di sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche, contribuendo direttamente alla stabilità e alle prestazioni di produzione. Contatto - Unisciti al nostro team innovativo come Ingegnere di Manutenzione Shift e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel cuore della produzione di semiconduttori! - Con una forte attenzione ai processi di incisione, lavorerai con tecnologia all'avanguardia per ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e garantire operazioni senza interruzioni. - Questa è la tua opportunità di collaborare con gli esperti, contribuire a progetti innovativi e crescere in un ambiente dinamico e high-tech. - Se siete appassionati di precisione e innovazione, vogliamo sentirvi!
descriptionByLocale.en:
## Mansioni - Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability - Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners - Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance - Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements - Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals - Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems - Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency - Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment ##
• Requisiti - Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent) - 2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries - Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems) - Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems - Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations - Good communication skills in English (German is a plus) ##
• Cosa offriamo - You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key. - Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes. - This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance. ## Contatto - Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! - With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. - This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. - If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Functional Lead Secondary Engineering Standardization Team 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team.   Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. Notre unité Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, est active dans le développement et la production de systèmes de commutation isothermes. Nous assurons la haute fiabilité de nos systèmes en utilisant des outils et des méthodes de développement de pointe. Pour notre unité d'affaires Produits haute tension, nous recherchons un responsable fonctionnel de l'équipe de normalisation en génie secondaire. Dans cette position difficile, vous prendrez la direction fonctionnelle de l'équipe de normalisation pour faire avancer la normalisation et les améliorations des produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'ingénierie secondaire en Suisse, en Allemagne et en Inde et développerez une feuille de route de normalisation qui guidera le développement de notre produit pour l'avenir. En collaboration avec l'équipe de normalisation, vous assurerez la mise en œuvre réussie des améliorations, telles que la publication de nouveaux modèles et de lignes directrices d'ingénierie qui permettent à l'ingénierie de réaliser ses projets de manière efficace et de haute qualité. Vos antécédents Expérience en génie électrique Capacité démontrée de diriger avec succès, soit en poste de direction, soit dans des projets complexes et exigeants Expérience solide en génie des équipements secondaires (LCC) comme génie secondaire PM Expérience des outils correspondants utilisés pour la préparation en génie secondaire pour assumer le rôle de leadership fonctionnel au sein d'une équipe. jobs.title: Internship in Low-Code Development 80 - 100% (f/m(d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working  Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

In this role, you will ensure full compliance with all relevant environmental laws, regulations, and permits, while fostering strong relationships with community stakeholders and environmental authorities. You will develop, implement, and maintain robust environmental policies and procedures that promote accountability across the organization. By conducting environmental risk assessments, delivering training on sustainability practices, and leading initiatives that improve resource efficiency, you will directly contribute to reducing the factory's environmental footprint and supporting long-term operational excellence.  On the H&S part, you'll be required to support main Health and Safety development activities organized by the HSE Manager, delivering results according to Management expectations.  Please submit your application in English.   How you'll make an impact  Ensure regulatory compliance with Swiss environmental law and related frameworks (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), including permit management and coordination with cantonal authorities (BAFU)  Lead environmental impact assessments for new production lines, plant changes, and modifications, ensuring alignment with internal environmental policies  Manage waste and disposals, including segregation, traceability, registers, supplier audits, and all special waste streams, while supporting wastereduction and VVEA improvement initiatives  Oversee chemical compliance, including ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, Manage and maintain Safety SDS requirements, and notifications of new substances  Support safe handling and storage of dangerous goods (DG) by coordinating with relevant departments and ensuring ongoing compliance  Plan and conduct environmental audits and inspections, identifying improvement areas and ensuring timely corrective actions, also providing environmental compliance support and training to Engineering, Maintenance, and overall Business Unit, including REACH\/RoHS documentation and sustainability-related data needs  On the Health and Safety part, you're required to support HSE manager in H&S-related topics managing production activities and equipment with the highest safety standards, both on the practical part and on documentation preparation.  Support HSE reporting activities required by governmental or Hitachi Energy internal stakeholders.  Your background  Min. 3 years of experience in environmental roles within the industrial sector and strong knowledge of Swiss environmental regulations and compliance obligations   Solid understanding of best practices in emissions, waste, water, chemicals, and sustainability   Strong analytical skills, including environmental data processing and use of relevant software tools   Basic knowledge of H&S principles and concepts   Excellent command of Office 365 applications   Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess environmental risks and develop effective mitigation strategies   Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engaging with diverse internal and external stakeholders   Fluent in Italian and English  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

I compiti chiave sul lato ambientale saranno legati alla salvaguardia dell'integrità ambientale del nostro sito e alla promozione delle nostre ambizioni di sostenibilità. In questo ruolo, si assicurerà il pieno rispetto di tutte le pertinenti leggi ambientali, regolamenti e permessi, mentre promuovendo forti relazioni con le parti interessate della comunità e le autorità ambientali. Si svilupperà, implementerà e manterrà robuste politiche e procedure ambientali che promuovono la responsabilità in tutta l'organizzazione. Condurre valutazioni dei rischi ambientali, fornire formazione sulle pratiche di sostenibilità e le principali iniziative che migliorano l'efficienza delle risorse, contribuirà direttamente a ridurre l'impronta ambientale della fabbrica e sostenere l'eccellenza operativa a lungo termine. Nella parte H&S, sarai tenuto a sostenere le principali attività di sviluppo della salute e della sicurezza organizzate dal HSE Manager, offrendo risultati secondo le aspettative della Direzione. Invia la tua richiesta in inglese. Assicurare il rispetto delle normative in materia ambientale e dei relativi quadri (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), comprese le norme relative alla gestione dei permessi e al coordinamento con le autorità cantonali (BAFU) Nella parte Salute e Sicurezza, sei tenuto a sostenere HSE manager in temi legati alla H&S che gestiscono attività di produzione e attrezzature con i più elevati standard di sicurezza, sia sul piano pratico che sulla preparazione della documentazione. Sostenere le attività di reportistica HSE richieste dagli stakeholder interni governativi o Hitachi Energy. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de l'environnement et de la sécurité des employés faisant partie de l'équipe locale de SSE, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la participation au développement de SSE, en mettant l'accent sur le thème environnemental, mais en accordant un bon soutien aux activités de SSE. Les principales tâches du côté environnemental seront liées à la protection de l'intégrité environnementale de notre site et à la promotion de nos ambitions en matière de durabilité. Dans ce rôle, vous assurerez le plein respect de toutes les lois, règlements et permis environnementaux pertinents, tout en favorisant des relations solides avec les intervenants communautaires et les autorités environnementales. Vous allez élaborer, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des politiques et des procédures environnementales solides qui favorisent la reddition de comptes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. En procédant à des évaluations des risques environnementaux, en offrant une formation sur les pratiques de durabilité et en dirigeant des initiatives qui améliorent l'efficacité des ressources, vous contribuerez directement à réduire l'empreinte environnementale de l'usine et à soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle à long terme. En ce qui a trait à la santé et à la sécurité, vous devrez appuyer les principales activités de développement de la santé et de la sécurité organisées par le gestionnaire de l'ESH, en donnant des résultats en fonction des attentes de la direction. Veuillez soumettre votre candidature en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Assurer la conformité réglementaire avec le droit suisse de l'environnement et les cadres connexes (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), y compris la gestion des permis et la coordination avec les autorités cantonales (BAFU) Diriger les évaluations de l'impact environnemental pour les nouvelles lignes de production, les changements d'usine et les modifications, assurer l'alignement sur les politiques environnementales internes Gérer les déchets et les éliminations, y compris la ségrégation, la traçabilité, les registres, les audits des fournisseurs et tous les flux spéciaux de déchets, tout en appuyant les initiatives de réduction des déchets et d'amélioration de la VVEA Surveiller la conformité chimique, y compris ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, gérer et maintenir les exigences de la SDD en matière de sécurité, et les notifications de nouvelles substances Soutenir la manutention et l'entreposage sécuritaires des marchandises dangereuses (DG) en coordonnant avec les ministères concernés et en assurant la conformité continue Plan et des vérifications et inspections environnementales, en déterminant les domaines d'amélioration et en veillant à des mesures Pour ce qui est de la santé et de la sécurité, vous êtes tenu d'appuyer le gestionnaire de l'ESH dans la gestion des activités de production et de l'équipement ayant les normes de sécurité les plus élevées, tant sur le plan pratique que sur la préparation de la documentation. Appuyer les activités de rapport sur les ESE requises par les intervenants internes du gouvernement ou de Hitachi Energy. Vos antécédents 3 ans d'expérience dans les rôles environnementaux dans le secteur industriel et une solide connaissance de la réglementation et des obligations suisses en matière d'environnement Compréhension solide des meilleures pratiques en matière d'émissions, de déchets, d'eau, de produits chimiques et de durabilité Fortes compétences analytiques, y compris le traitement des données environnementales et l'utilisation d'outils logiciels pertinents Connaissance de base des principes et concepts de H & S Excellente maîtrise des applications Office 365 Fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'évaluer les risques environnementaux et d'élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation efficaces Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite pour s'engager auprès de divers intervenants internes et externes Fluent en italien et en anglais Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

jobs.description:
Über die Position Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Leistungshalbleitern bietet Hitachi Energy eines der vielfältigsten Produktportfolios. Darunter; Thyristoren, Dioden, Gate-Turn-Off-Thyristoren (GTOs), Integrated Gate-Commutated Thyristors (IGCTs), Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistors (IGBTs) und MOSFETs -, die in Industrie, Energieübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbaren Energien für ihre hohe Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit geschätzt werden. Für unser Team suchen wir befristet eine\/n Automatiker\/in, der\/die beim Aufbau und der Inbetriebnahme unserer Leistungshalbleiter-Testsysteme mitwirkt. Das kannst du bewirken Aufbau von Leistungshalbleiter-Testsystemen inklusive Mechanik, Elektrik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik Durchführung von Anpassungsarbeiten an fehlerhaften Konstruktionen, Fertigungsteilen oder Schemen Kontrolle aller mechanischen, pneumatischen, elektrischen, programmierten und hydraulischen Funktionen Durchführung von Erdungsmessungen (Überprüfung der Durchgängigkeit des Schutzleitersystems nach EN 60204-1 18b) Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Isolationskoordinationsprotokollen Durchführung der Inbetriebnahme und Isolationskoordination von Testsystemen Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Normvorgaben Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Prozessen und Systemen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Automatiker\/in EFZ (evtl. mit höherer Fachschule), idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung in der Montage Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Fundiertes Know-how in der mechanischen Bearbeitung von Materialien (Drehen, Fräsen, Bohren, Sägen etc.) Vertrautheit mit Leistungshalbleitern, Messtechnik sowie relevanten Richtlinien und Normen Sicherer Umgang mit Office 365 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Befristete Position in einem international führenden Hightech-Unternehmen Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle

In dieser Funktion verantworten Sie das Bid Management sowie die Erstellung qualitativ hochwertiger und wettbewerbsfähiger Angebote für unser Portfolio von Hochspannungsprodukten und Transformatoren. Sie entwickeln das Bid-&-Proposal-Team weiter und führen es fachlich wie disziplinarisch. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinieren Sie sämtliche relevanten internen Stakeholder und tragen mit termingerechten, qualitativ überzeugenden Angeboten massgeblich zur erfolgreichen Entwicklung des Schweizer Marktes bei. Wir suchen eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zielerreichung und im Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams in einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bid-&-Proposal- sowie Order-Handling-Teams mit klarer Ausrichtung auf Wachstum und Geschäftsergebnisse im Einklang mit der Hitachi-Energy-Strategie Weiterentwicklung von Kompetenzen, Strukturen und Prozessen zur Sicherstellung eines leistungsfähigen, motivierten und engagierten Teams Gesamtverantwortung für Angebotsprozesse und Auftragsabwicklung im Produktgeschäft für den Schweizer Markt – termingerecht, qualitäts- und kundengerecht Sicherstellung der fristgerechten, korrekten und regelkonformen Angebotsabgabe gemäss Kunden-, Vertrags- und internen 
• Anforderungen Entwicklung und Steuerung von Angebotsstrategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal sowie den Werken Aktive Gestaltung effizienter Schnittstellen zwischen Vertrieb, Engineering und Produktion sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Angebotsmanagement‑Prozesse Vorleben der Hitachi-Energy-Werte, insbesondere Sicherheit und Integrität Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor\/Master) im technischen oder ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich; betriebswirtschaftliche Zusatzqualifikation von Vorteil Mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, Bid & Proposal oder Projektmanagement Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination von Teams sowie im Management komplexer Stakeholder‑Strukturen Branchenkenntnisse im Energiesektor sowie ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung Tiefes Verständnis von Ausschreibungs‑ und Auftragsabwicklungsprozessen, inkl. SAP‑Grundlagen, kaufmännischer Abläufe, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risiko‑ sowie Claims‑Management Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, Team-Player Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, engagierten und kollaborativen Umfeld Klare Förderung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch strukturierte Lern- und Entwicklungsangebote Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt Eine einzigartige Kultur: Bringen Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihre Ideen ein und gestalten Sie mit uns eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft Flexible Arbeitsmodelle inkl. Hybrid‑ und Remote‑Optionen Attraktives, wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungs‑ und Leistungspaket

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni - Responsabilità del Bid Management e della creazione di offerte di alta qualità e competitive per il nostro portafoglio di prodotti ad alta tensione e trasformari - Sviluppo e guida del team Bid & Propost e Order Handling, con un focus sul development e sui risultati aziendali in linea con la strategia Hitachi Energy - Coordinamento di tutti i stakeholder interni precedenti per garantire l'organizzazione tempestiva, di alta qualità e in linea con le esigenze del cliente delle offerte - Sviluppo delle competenze, delle strutture e dei processi per garantire un team performante, motivato e impegnato - Responsabilità completa per i processi di offerta e l'esecuzione degli ordini nel business dei prodotti per il mercato svizzero, nel rispetto dei tempi, della qualità e delle esigenze del cliente - Garanzia del rispetto dei termini, della correttezza e del rispetto delle regole per le offerte in conformità a tutte le richieste del cliente, ai contratti e all normative interne - Sviluppo e gestione delle strategie di offerta in collaborazione con Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal e i siti di produzione - Gestione efficiente delle barriere tra vendite, ingegneria e produzione e miglioramento continuo dei processi di gestione delle offerte - Rappresentanza dei valori Hitachi Energy, in particolare sicurezza e apparenza
• Requisiti - Laurea triennale o magistrale in ambito tecnico o ingegneristico; preferibile formazione complementare in ambito economico - Almeno 10 anni di esperienza nel campo delle vendite tecniche, Bid & Propost o project management - Esperienza comprovata nella guida o nella coordinamento di team e nella gestione di strutture complesse di stakeholder - Conoscenza del settore energetico e forte orientamento al cliente - Profonda comprensione dei processi di gara e di esecuzione degli ordini, inclusi i fondamenti di SAP, i processi amministrativi, le minacce contrattuali, la gestione del rischio e dei fattori - Ottime capacità comunicative, lavoro autonomo e proattivo, spirito di squadra - Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia in parlato che in scritto; il francese o l'italiano sono un vantaggio Cosa? - Lavoro vario e responsabile in un ambiente dinamico, impegnato e collaborativo - Sostegno allo sviluppo delle competenze e delle capacità personali attraverso l'offerta di formazione e sviluppo strutturate - Cultura aziendale che apprezza la collaborazione, la diversità e le diverse prospettive - Unica cultura: porti la tua personalità, la tua passione e le do idee e contribuisci con noi a un futuro energetico sostenibile - Modelli di lavoro flessibili, inclusi

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - Grid Automation Control & Protection 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un Senior Project Engineer con un forte focus sui sistemi di protezione per i progetti di automazione di sottostazione. In questo ruolo, prenderete la proprietà tecnica del campo di controllo e protezione all'interno di complessi (sotto-) progetti di trasmissione in Svizzera e a livello internazionale, agendo come autorità tecnica chiave dal design di base attraverso la messa in servizio. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con la gestione del progetto, i clienti e i team di ingegneria multidisciplinari per definire, coordinare e fornire soluzioni di protezione robuste in linea con i requisiti di sistema, gli standard applicabili e le best practice Hitachi Energy. Potrai diventare parte di una comunità di ingegneria di livello mondiale all'interno del nostro hub europeo, lavorando insieme a colleghi altamente esperti con profonda esperienza nell'esecuzione di progetti di grandi e complessi in tutto il mondo. Questa posizione offre un ambiente eccellente per imparare, sviluppare e contribuire attivamente allo scopo di Hitachi Energy di promuovere un sistema energetico sostenibile, flessibile e sicuro. È un'occasione unica per far parte di una fase emozionante in cui l'elettricità sta diventando la spina dorsale di una società sostenibile. Come farete un impatto Piombo e possiate il campo di ingegneria di controllo e protezione nei progetti di sistema di automazione di sottostazione Definire concetti di protezione e filosofie in stretta collaborazione con l'ingegneria di piombo tecnico e con i clienti durante la fase di progettazione di base Coordinate e guidare l'ingegneria dettagliata di Protezione e controllo, garantendo l'allineamento con SCADA, il controllo delle stazioni e le discipline di sicurezza informatica Specificare, configurare e la protezione dei test La tua laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica o equivalente, con una solida esperienza nell'ingegneria della protezione per sistemi di automazione di sottostazione Prova competenza in sistemi di protezione per (sub-)sottostazioni di trasmissione Forte conoscenza di IEC 61850 e architetture di automazione di sottostazione Esperienza con Hitachi Energy Relion® protezione IEDs è un forte vantaggio Adrible per lavorare indipendentemente, prendere decisioni tecniche e gestire interfacce in progetti complessi.
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Um unser Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen Senior Project Engineer mit einem starken Fokus auf Schutzsysteme für Unterstationsautomatisierungsprojekte. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie technisches Eigentum am Kontroll- und Schutzbereich in komplexen (Sub-)Transmissionsprojekten in der Schweiz und international, als zentrale technische Behörde vom Basisdesign bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Sie arbeiten eng mit Projektmanagement, Kunden und multidisziplinären Engineering-Teams zusammen, um robuste Schutzlösungen nach Systemanforderungen, anwendbaren Standards und Hitachi Energy Best Practices zu definieren, zu koordinieren und zu liefern. Sie werden Teil einer Weltklasse-Engineering-Community in unserem European Hub werden, die zusammen mit erfahrenen Kollegen mit tiefem Know-how in der Umsetzung von großen und komplexen Projekten weltweit arbeitet. Diese Position bietet ein ausgezeichnetes Umfeld, um ein nachhaltiges, flexibles und sicheres Energiesystem zu entwickeln und aktiv zu fördern. Es ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, Teil einer spannenden Phase zu sein, in der Strom zum Rückgrat einer nachhaltigen Gesellschaft wird. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Lead and Own the Control & Protection Engineering-Bereich in Unterstationsautomatisierungs-System-Projekten Definieren Sie Schutzkonzepte und Philosophien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der technischen Lead Engineering und mit Kunden in der Basis-Design-Phase Koordinieren und führen Sie die Protection & Control Detail Engineering, die Ausrichtung mit SCADA, Station Control und Cyber-Sicherheitsdisziplinen Spezifizieren, konfigurieren und testen IEDs in Übereinstimmung mit Kundenanforderungen, Gittercodes, und Standards Support und Standards Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig, mit solider Erfahrung in der Protektionstechnik für Unterstationsautomatisierungssysteme Proven Know-how in Schutzsystemen für (Unter-)Übertragungsstationen Starkes Wissen über IEC 61850 und Unterstationsautomatisierungsarchitekturen Erfahrung mit Hitachi Energy Relion® Schutz IEDs ist ein starker Vorteil, um unabhängig zu arbeiten, technische Entscheidungen zu treffen und Schnittstellen in komplexen Projekten zu optimieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons un ingénieur de projet senior qui s'intéresse aux systèmes de protection pour les projets d'automatisation de sous-station. Dans ce rôle, vous prendrez la maîtrise technique du champ d'application Contrôle & Protection dans le cadre de projets (sous-)transmission complexes en Suisse et à l'échelle internationale, agissant en tant qu'autorité technique clé de la conception de base par la mise en service. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion de projet, les clients et d'ingénierie multidisciplinaire pour définir, coordonner et fournir des solutions de protection robustes en fonction des exigences du système, des normes applicables et des meilleures pratiques d'Hitachi Energy. Vous deviendrez membre d'une communauté d'ingénieurs de calibre mondial au sein de notre European Hub, travaillant aux côtés de collègues hautement expérimentés avec une expertise profonde dans la réalisation de grands et complexes projets dans le monde entier. Cette position offre un excellent environnement pour apprendre, développer et contribuer activement à l'objectif d'Hitachi Energy de faire progresser un système énergétique durable, flexible et sûr. C'est une occasion unique de participer à une phase passionnante où l'électricité devient l'épine dorsale d'une société durable. Comment faire un impact Lead et posséder le champ d'ingénierie de Contrôle & Protection dans les projets de systèmes d'automatisation de sous-station Définir des concepts et des philosophies de protection en étroite collaboration avec l'ingénierie de pointe technique et avec les clients pendant la phase de conception de base Coordonner et guider l'ingénierie détaillée de Protection & Control, en assurant l'alignement avec SCADA, le contrôle de station et les disciplines de cybersécurité Spécifiez, configurez et testez la protection des DEI conformément aux exigences du client, aux codes de grille et aux normes. Votre formation Baccalauréat en génie électrique ou équivalent, avec une solide expérience en ingénierie de protection pour les systèmes d'automatisation des sous-stations Expertise éprouvée dans les systèmes de protection pour (sous-)transmission des sous-stations Forte connaissance des architectures d'automatisation des sous-stations IEC 61850 et des architectures d'automatisation des sous-stations L'expérience avec Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs est un avantage solide Capable de travailler indépendamment, de prendre des décisions techniques et de gérer des interfaces dans des projets complexes Fortes compétences en communication et un esprit structuré et axé sur la qualité Fluent en anglais; l'allemand est un avantage En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Transport, Trade & Logistics Junior Specialist Export 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern   Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.

jobs.title: Product Engineer – Power Semiconductors Module Packaging (BiMOS) 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'opportunità In qualità di Product Engineer, sarai un membro fondamentale del team di ingegneria del prodotto BiMOS, giocando un ruolo chiave nell'interfaccia di produzione, R&D e qualità. Con sede a Lenzburg, Svizzera, si prende la proprietà end-to-end di una piattaforma di prodotto e la sua ottimizzazione utilizzando l'analisi avanzata dei dati e metodi di miglioramento continuo. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente la qualità del prodotto, la resa e la competitività dei costi nella produzione di semiconduttori ad alta potenza. Mansioni - Monitorare, analizzare e interpretare i dati di rendimento e qualità per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e promuovere miglioramenti sostenibili nei costi, qualità e resa - Guidare ed eseguire progetti di miglioramento utilizzando metodologie come Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D e framework correlati - Prendere la piena proprietà del prodotto dopo la consegna R&D, compreso il coordinamento e il monitoraggio di nuova rampa di prodotto nella linea di fabbricazione - Eseguire l'analisi delle cause e la risoluzione dei problemi dei difetti del prodotto, delle debolezze e dei problemi di qualità, derivanti da chiare conclusioni sulle lacune di processo e di progettazione - Mantenere, migliorare e implementare metodi di acquisizione dei dati, analisi e reporting per supportare il processo decisionale guidato dai dati - Gli ingegneri del processo di supporto e R&D con una forte competenza tecnica e approcci strutturati di problem solving
• Requisiti - Il tuo background Laurea Magistrale o PhD in Fisica, Ingegneria Elettrica, o una disciplina correlata - Forte competenza nell'analisi statistica, nelle metodologie di problem solving e nelle tecniche di analisi dei dati avanzate - L'esperienza di produzione dei semiconduttori è un vantaggio - Esperienza comprovata che conduce progetti di miglioramento complessi, idealmente con piccoli team funzionali - Confortevole lavoro in un'organizzazione internazionale, matrice, con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione - Giocatore di squadra innovativo e di qualità con un'alta volontà di imparare e prendere la proprietà - Ottimo comando di tedesco e inglese (scritto e parlato, livello B2/C1) Cosa? - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione L'opportunité En tant qu'ingénieur de produits, vous serez un membre essentiel de l'équipe d'ingénierie de produits BiMOS, jouant un rôle clé à l'interface de la fabrication, de la R-D et de la qualité. jobs.title: Internship Production Development 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and private transportation more energy-efficient, while our technology also enables the production and transportation of renewable energy from the production site to the consumer. A new production facility is being established in Prague for one of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) products. This move is motivated by considerations of capacity and business continuity. As part of your Internship in Production Development, you will assist with the transfer of production capabilities from Lenzburg to Prague. You play a vital role in facilitating the introduction and ramp-up of Hitachi Energy Semiconductors products at our second manufacturing site in Prague \/ Czech Republic. 
• Your responsibilities focus on ensuring operational excellence, process integrity, and effective knowledge transfer across locations. How you'll make an impact Supporting the implementation and qualification of new production tools, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards Assisting with equipment integration as well as the collection and analysis of production and process data Establishing process quality control procedures and corresponding control loops to maintain product consistency and compliance Organizing and supporting training of new production personnel, ensuring effective knowledge transfer from the Lenzburg site to the new factory Supporting product qualification by coordinating production of samples and testing activities Support the implementation of logistical flows for raw materials and processed parts between Lenzburg and Prague Ensuring comprehensive and accurate documentation of processes, work instructions, supporting materials, production tools, and their configurations, to support operational excellence and future audits Your background Study engineering, physics, chemistry, production technology, or related disciplines; holding a bachelor's degree is preferred. The assignment can be part of a master's thesis Show genuine interest in semiconductor backend manufacturing, including areas like innovative processes, logistics, and governance Show effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, as well as an interest in international collaboration and knowledge sharing Exhibit attention to detail in documentation and process setup, along with organizational abilities for supporting training, planning, and knowledge transfer Adapt easily to changing environments, embrace new tools, and commit to a six- to nine-month assignment split between Switzerland and the Czech Republic, supporting both operational and developmental activities English at minimum C1 level. Mastering of German is an advantage More about us This internship provides hands-on experience with manufacturing processes and operational excellence in a leading power semiconductor environment. It offers the chance to develop technical and organizational skills while supporting a major industrial expansion across Switzerland and the Czech Republic. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Nel nostro impianto BiMOS Backend di Lenzburg, Svizzera e Power Semiconductor di Praga, Repubblica Ceca, produciamo semiconduttori di potenza efficienti e di alta qualità per l'uso in unità di controllo motore, applicazioni di trazione, applicazioni industriali e sistemi di inverter. In questo modo, forniamo un contributo decisivo per rendere più efficiente l'industria, i trasporti pubblici e privati, mentre la nostra tecnologia consente anche la produzione e il trasporto di energia rinnovabile dal sito produttivo al consumatore. Un nuovo impianto di produzione è stato istituito a Praga per uno dei nostri prodotti originali per il produttore di apparecchiature (OEM). Come parte del vostro stage in sviluppo di produzione, vi aiuterà con il trasferimento di capacità produttive da Lenzburg a Praga. Si gioca un ruolo vitale nel facilitare l'introduzione e la rampa di prodotti semiconduttori di energia Hitachi nel nostro secondo sito di produzione a Praga \ / Repubblica Ceca.
