Sostenere l'implementazione e la qualificazione di nuovi strumenti di produzione, assicurando loro di soddisfare gli standard di prestazioni e affidabilità Assistendo all'integrazione delle attrezzature, nonché alla raccolta e all'analisi dei dati di produzione e di processo Istituzione di procedure di controllo della qualità e dei corrispondenti loop di controllo per mantenere la coerenza e la conformità del prodotto Organizzare e sostenere la formazione di nuovi personale di produzione, garantendo un trasferimento di conoscenza efficace dal sito di Lenzburg alla nuova fabbrica Il tuo background Ingegneria di studio, fisica, chimica, tecnologia di produzione o discipline correlate; tenere un diploma di laurea è preferito. L'assegnazione può essere parte della tesi di un maestro Mostra un vero interesse per la produzione di semiconduttori, tra cui aree come processi innovativi, logistica e governance Mostra competenze di comunicazione efficaci per la collaborazione con diversi stakeholder e team interfunzionali, nonché un interesse per la collaborazione internazionale e la condivisione delle conoscenze Mostra attenzione ai dettagli nella documentazione e nella configurazione dei processi, insieme alle capacità organizzative per sostenere la formazione, la pianificazione e il trasferimento di conoscenze Adapt facilmente per cambiare ambienti, abbracciare nuovi strumenti, e impegnarsi a un compito operativo di sei mesi in Svizzera a nove Mastering of German è un vantaggio Più su di noi Questo tirocinio fornisce esperienza pratica con i processi produttivi e l'eccellenza operativa in un ambiente semiconduttore di potenza leader. Offre la possibilità di sviluppare competenze tecniche e organizzative, supportando una grande espansione industriale in tutta la Svizzera e nella Repubblica Ceca. Begleitend zur Geräteintegration sowie zur Erfassung und Analyse von Produktions- und Prozessdaten Prozessqualitätskontrollverfahren und entsprechende Regelkreise zur Aufrechterhaltung der Produktkonsistenz und Compliance Organisation und Unterstützung der Ausbildung von neuen Produktionspersonal, um einen effektiven Wissenstransfer vom Standort Lenzburg zur neuen Fabrik zu gewährleisten. jobs.title: R&D Power Semiconductor Chip Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'opportunità Nei nostri gruppi di chip semiconduttori R&D BiMOS di Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, stiamo sviluppando dispositivi semiconduttori di potenza avanzati attraverso più classi di tensione. I nostri prodotti di alta qualità sono fabbricati in siti di produzione interni ed esterni e consegnati ai clienti in tutto il mondo attraverso una vasta gamma di applicazioni, tra cui l'energia industriale, rinnovabile, trazione ed e-mobility. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un motivato R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist per contribuire allo sviluppo di tecnologie semiconduttori di potenza di nuova generazione. In questo ruolo, ci si concentrerà su dispositivi basati sul silicio (con una forte esposizione ai diodi di potenza) mentre si espande verso concetti di dispositivi più ampi come IGBTs e MOSFETs. Questa posizione è ideale per i candidati con una solida base tecnica in fisica e simulazione dei dispositivi semiconduttori, che sono desiderosi di sviluppare ulteriormente le loro competenze in un ambiente R&D collaborativo e high-tech. Unisci un forte background tecnico nella fisica dei dispositivi semiconduttori con esperienza pratica nella simulazione e nello sviluppo tecnologico? Siete motivati a prendere la proprietà dei compiti di sviluppo durante l'apprendimento continuo e la crescita? Allora non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione. Mansioni - Contribuire allo sviluppo di chip semiconduttore di potenza di nuova generazione, con una forte attenzione ai diodi di potenza in silicio e alle relative tecnologie di dispositivo - Supporta il ciclo di sviluppo della tecnologia end-to-end e del prodotto, dal concetto e dalla simulazione fino alla valutazione di validazione e affidabilità - Applicare e sviluppare ulteriormente i modelli di simulazione TCAD per comprendere il comportamento del dispositivo e ottimizzare le prestazioni, la resa e i costi - Collaborare a stretto contatto con ingegneri di processo, team di caratterizzazione e affidabilità, garantendo l'allineamento tra design e manifatabilità - Prendere la proprietà di singoli pacchetti di lavoro o sottoprogetti, contribuendo a obiettivi e tempi di progetto complessi - Miglioramento continuo attraverso l'analisi, la modellazione e l'ottimizzazione dei dati - Contribuire attivamente alla condivisione della conoscenza all'interno del team e costruire una forte comprensione a livello di sistemi di dispositivi e processi semiconduttori
• Requisiti - Master o PhD in Fisica, Ingegneria Elettrica, o un campo correlato, con focus sulla fisica dei dispositivi semiconduttori - Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo dei dispositivi a semiconduttore di potenza, idealmente con esposizione ai diodi di potenza in silicio - Forte esperienza pratica con strumenti di simulazione TCAD (ad esempio Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Buona comprensione della fisica, delle caratteristiche e dei processi di sviluppo tecnologico dei dispositivi semiconduttori - Esposizione alla collaborazione interfunzionale con team di processo, caratterizzazione e affidabilità - Esperienza iniziale nel possedere compiti tecnici o supervisionare i profili junior è un plus - La familiarità con gli aspetti di integrazione del processo o gli approcci di modellazione è considerata un vantaggio - Self-driven, analitico e desideroso di imparare e crescere in un ambiente R&D ad alte prestazioni - Proficienza in inglese con forti capacità di comunicazione e presentazione Contatto

Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit In unseren R&D BiMOS Halbleiterchip-Gruppen bei Hitachi Energy Semiconductors entwickeln wir fortschrittliche Leistungshalbleiter-Geräte über mehrere Spannungsklassen hinweg. Unsere hochwertigen Produkte werden an internen und externen Produktionsstandorten hergestellt und an Kunden weltweit über eine breite Palette von Anwendungen geliefert, darunter industrielle, erneuerbare Energien, Traktion und E-Mobilität. Derzeit suchen wir einen motivierten F&D Semiconductor Chip Spezialisten, um zur Entwicklung von Leistungshalbleitertechnologien der nächsten Generation beizutragen. In dieser Rolle konzentrieren Sie sich auf siliziumbasierte Geräte (mit starker Belichtung mit Leistungsdioden) und erweitern sich auf breitere Gerätekonzepte wie IGBTs und MOSFETs. Diese Position ist ideal für Kandidaten mit einer soliden technischen Grundlage in der Halbleiter-Geräte-Physik und -Simulation, die ihre Expertise in einer kollaborativen, High-Tech-FuD-Umgebung weiterentwickeln möchten. Kombinieren Sie einen starken technischen Hintergrund in der Halbleiter-Gerätephysik mit praktischem Erfahrung in der Simulation und Technologieentwicklung? Sind Sie motiviert, das Eigentum an Entwicklungsaufgaben zu übernehmen, während Sie kontinuierlich lernen und wachsen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Mansion - Beitrag zur Entwicklung von Leistungshalbleiterchips der nächsten Generation, mit einem starken Fokus auf Silizium-Leistungsdioden und verwandten Gerätetechnologien - Unterstützung des End-to-End-Technologie- und Produktentwicklungszyklus, von Konzept und Simulation bis hin zur Validierung und Zuverlässigkeitsbewertung - Bewerben und entwickeln TCAD-Simulationsmodelle, um das Geräteverhalten zu verstehen und Leistung, Ertrag und Kosten zu optimieren - enge Zusammenarbeit mit Prozessingenieuren, Charakterisierungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsteams, die eine Ausrichtung zwischen Design und Manufakturabilität gewährleisten - Nehmen Sie das Eigentum an individuellen Arbeitspaketen oder Teilprojekten und tragen zu Gesamtprojektzielen und Zeitplänen bei - kontinuierliche Verbesserung durch datengesteuerte Analyse-, Modellierungs- und Optimierungsansätze - Aktiv zum Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Teams beitragen und ein starkes System-Level-Verstehen von Halbleiter-Geräten und Prozessen aufbauen Voraussetzungen - Master's oder PhD in Physik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit Fokus auf Halbleiter-Gerätephysik - Erprobte Erfahrung in der Leistungshalbleiter-Geräteentwicklung, ideal mit der Belichtung mit Silizium-Leistungsdioden - Starke praktische Erfahrung mit TCAD-Simulationswerkzeugen (z.B. Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Gutes Verständnis der Halbleiter-Gerätephysik, Eigenschaften und Technologieentwicklungsprozesse - Ausstellung einer funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Prozess-, Charakterisierungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsteams - Erste Erfahrung in der eigenen technischen
• Aufgaben oder der Betreuung von Junior-Profilen ist ein Plus - Vertraulichkeit mit Prozessintegrationsaspekten oder Modellierungsansätzen gilt als Vorteil - Selbstgetriebene, analytische und eifrige, in einer leistungsfähigen FuE-Umgebung zu lernen und zu wachsen - Englischkenntnisse mit starken Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten Contattoo
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione L'opportunité Dans nos groupes de puces à semi-conducteurs BiMOS R&D chez Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, nous développons des dispositifs à semi-conducteurs de puissance de pointe dans plusieurs classes de tension. Nos produits de haute qualité sont fabriqués sur des sites de production internes et externes et livrés à des clients du monde entier dans une large gamme d'applications, y compris l'énergie industrielle, renouvelable, traction et e-mobilité. Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un spécialiste des puces semi-conducteurs de R-D motivé pour contribuer au développement de technologies de semi-conducteurs de nouvelle génération. Dans ce rôle, vous vous concentrerez sur les dispositifs à base de silicium (avec une forte exposition aux diodes de puissance) tout en vous étendant vers des concepts d'appareils plus larges tels que les IGBT et les MOSFET. Ce poste est idéal pour les candidats ayant une solide base technique en physique et simulation des dispositifs semi-conducteurs, qui sont désireux de développer leur expertise dans un environnement collaboratif de R-D de haute technologie. Combinez-vous une solide expérience technique en physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs avec une expérience pratique en simulation et en développement technologique? Êtes-vous motivé à prendre en charge les tâches de développement tout en apprenant et en augmentant continuellement? Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature. Mansioni - Contribuer au développement de puces semi-conducteurs de nouvelle génération, en mettant fortement l'accent sur les diodes de puissance au silicium et les technologies connexes - Soutenir le cycle de développement de la technologie et des produits de bout en bout, du concept et de la simulation à l'évaluation de la validation et de la fiabilité - Appliquer et développer des modèles de simulation TCAD pour comprendre le comportement de l'appareil et optimiser les performances, le rendement et le coût - Collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieurs de process, les équipes de caractérisation et de fiabilité, en assurant l'alignement entre conception et fabrication - Prendre en charge les travaux individuels ou les sous-projets, contribuant ainsi aux objectifs et aux échéanciers globaux du projet - Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des méthodes d'analyse, de modélisation et d'optimisation fondées sur les données - Contribuer activement au partage des connaissances au sein de l'équipe et développer une solide compréhension au niveau des systèmes des dispositifs et procédés à semi-conducteurs
• Requisiti - Maîtrise ou doctorat en physique, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe, mettant l'accent sur la physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs - Expérience éprouvée dans le développement de dispositifs semi-conducteurs de puissance, idéalement avec l'exposition aux diodes de puissance en silicium - Forte expérience pratique avec les outils de simulation TCAD (par exemple Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Bonne compréhension de la physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs, des caractéristiques et des processus de développement technologique - Exposition à une collaboration interfonctionnelle avec des équipes de processus, de caractérisation et de fiabilité - L'expérience initiale dans la possession de tâches techniques ou la supervision de profils juniors est un plus - La connaissance des aspects d'intégration des processus ou des approches de modélisation est considérée comme un avantage - Autodidacte, analytique et désireux d'apprendre et de grandir dans un environnement de R-D performant - Maîtrise de l'anglais avec de solides compétences en communication et présentation Contatto

jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.title: Senior Quality Expert – Composites Insulators High Voltage products (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role you drive excellence in quality, delivery, and compliance for the supply base. Furthermore, you ensure global processes are understood and implemented by the SCM network. As Senior Quality Expert – Composites Insulators, you will work closely with Hitachi Energy High Voltage Supply Chain, Technical Center, Group Product Service Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and the Global SCM team on all activity required to effectively support supplier quality requirements for assigned High Voltage commodities and suppliers. This position can be fulfilled remotely within Europe - please submit your documents in English. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute PPAP qualification plans, supplier audits, surveillance programs, and process\/product verification activities. Participate in supplier technical reviews, approval processes, and internal NPI (New Product Introduction) activities. Drive process quality improvements using Hitachi Energy tools, statistical methods, and CTQ evaluations. Conduct root‑cause analyses, FMEA, and corrective\/preventive actions to ensure sustainable process improvements. Reduce Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) based on customer and factory feedback, embedding CTQs in supplier processes. Support SQEs, Engineering, and suppliers by promoting industrial standards of excellence and best practices. Lead global activities for composites insulators, including Prior Failure Analysis (PFA) updates and special processes. Collaborate closely with Category teams to support CIPS strategies, supplier classification, selection, onboarding, and performance improvement. Your background Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical field (Master's degree preferred). 7+ years of experience in Supplier Quality or Manufacturing Process Quality, ideally for composite insulators. Strong knowledge of PPAP, APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, and process capability tools. Proven auditing experience and familiarity with ISO 9001 \/ IATF 16949 quality standards. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including RCA and 8D methodologies. Demonstrated ability to work in cross‑functional and global teams with strong stakeholder interaction. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to manage complex technical discussions. Willingness to travel up to 40% globally and lead activities across international supplier networks. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we know that people thrive when they have flexibility, trust, and the space to grow. Our working practices are designed to support both personal and business performance, giving you the freedom to develop your skills and shape your career. Benefits vary by country, based on local practices and job grade. We'll be happy to share specific details during the interview process.

jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit   Du möchtest die Zukunft der Energie mitgestalten? In unserem Hochstromlabor arbeitest du an der Spitze technologischer Entwicklungen und trägst dazu bei, unsere Produkte sicherer und leistungsfähiger zu machen. Als Test Engineer bist du Teil eines engagierten Teams, das Prüfprozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt und höchste Qualitätsstandards sicherstellt.   Das kannst du bewirken Planung von Prüfungen und Ressourcen sowie Definition von Prüfprogrammen und Spezifikationen unter Berücksichtigung aktueller internationaler Normen und kundenspezifischer 
• Anforderungen Auslegung und Überprüfung von Prüfkreisen und Versuchsanordnungen sowie Auswahl geeigneter Messmittel Durchführung von Entwicklungs- und Typprüfungen im Hochstromlabor (thermisch und dielektrisch) Sorgfältige und vollständige Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse Zeitnahe und effiziente Erstellung von Prüfberichten Erfassung und Dokumentation der verrechenbaren Laborleistungen Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prüf- und Arbeitsprozessen im Team Kostenkalkulation von Prüfungen und Laborleistungen sowie Erstellung von Angeboten für internationale Kunden Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektro- oder Energietechnik (FH oder Universität) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung Erste Berufserfahrung im Fachbereich von Vorteil Kenntnisse im Umgang mit verschiedenen Messgeräten und -verfahren Vorzugsweise Kenntnisse im Bereich elektrischer Kontakte Interesse an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Laborausrüstung und Prüfprozessen Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung mit Fokus auf Qualität und Effizienz Persönlichkeit mit guten organisatorischen Fähigkeiten Teamfähigkeit und hohe soziale Kompetenz Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy setzen wir auf Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und Innovation. Unsere Kultur fördert den offenen Austausch von Ideen, unterstützt individuelle Entwicklung und schafft ein Umfeld, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt und integriert werden. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft.

jobs.title: Global SCM Training Leader, BU Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Training Leader for the Business Unit Transformers to join our global training and supply chain community. In this role, you will define and drive the strategic direction, development, and deployment of Supply Chain Management (SCM) training programs across the business unit. You will play a key role in strengthening supply chain capabilities, enabling business performance, and supporting standardization, transformation, and continuous improvement across regions and functions. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of SCM capability development, work closely with global and regional stakeholders, and contribute to innovate, inspire and deliver transformative results in forward-thinking supply chain organization. How you`ll make an impact Define and implement the SCM training strategy and roadmap aligned with Business Unit supply chain priorities and transformation initiatives Design, develop, and deploy global SCM training programs, ensuring consistency, scalability, and operational relevance for global, regional and factory teams Establish specific KPIs to measure effectiveness, impact, and continuous improvement of learning initiatives in line with Hitachi Energy SCM functional and BU Training governance Collaborate with SCM leaders, Subject Matter Experts, and global\/regional stakeholders to identify capability gaps and ensure technical accuracy of training content Support the adoption of standardized SCM processes, tools, and best practices through structured learning solutions Drive a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing across the SCM community Promote innovative learning approaches and digital solutions to enhance engagement and learning effectiveness Your background Degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field Minimum of 10 years of experience in Supply Chain Management, training, learning & development, or a related functional leadership role Proven experience in designing, deploying, and governing global training programs within complex, matrix organizations Strong understanding of end‑to‑end SCM processes, including sourcing, planning, logistics, supplier management, and sustainability Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across global and regional teams Analytical mindset with experience in defining KPIs, measuring training impact, and driving continuous improvement Digital and technology savviness in managing and executing training using modern digital and AI-enabled technologies Ability to work effectively in an international environment and manage multiple projects\/initiatives in parallel with proven track record of successfully managed projects

jobs.title: Senior Key Account Manager Schweiz 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Als Senior Key Account Manager übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für einen strategisch bedeutenden Kunden im Bereich der Schweizer Energieinfrastruktur. Sie agieren dabei in einem anspruchsvollen, technisch geprägten Umfeld und arbeiten eng mit internen Fachbereichen zusammen, um nachhaltige Lösungen und langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt in der operativen und strategischen Betreuung des Kunden inklusive der aktiven Führung von Ausschreibungen und Angebotsprozessen.Sie fungieren als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Hitachi Energy und stellen eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit auf allen relevanten Ebenen sicher. Das können Sie bewirken Gesamtverantwortung für einen strategischen Key Account im Bereich Netzinfrastrukur  (Auftragseingang, Profitabilität, Kundenzufriedenheit) Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger, belastbarer Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern des Kunden auf allen Hierarchieebenen inklusive C-Level Sicherstellung eines konsistenten, professionellen Auftritts von Hitachi Energy gegenüber einem zentralen Akteur der Schweizer Energieversorgung Aktive Mitarbeit sowie fachliche Führung lokaler Ausschreibungen (Tenders) – von der Angebotsstrategie über die Verhandlungsphase bis zum Vertragsabschluss Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer kundenspezifischen Account‑ und Wachstumsstrategie (Marktpositionierung, Pipeline, Forecast, Wettbewerbsumfeld) Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Business Units und Funktionen (Sales, Engineering, Projektmanagement, Service etc.) zur optimalen Lösungs‑ und Angebotsgestaltung Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung standardisierter Sales‑ und CRM‑Prozesse und ‑Tools (z. B. Salesforce, Account Pläne, KPIs) Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Ergänzende Managementqualifikation wünschenswert Langjährige Erfahrung im Key Account Management oder im Vertrieb komplexer technischer Lösungen, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Übertragungs‑ und Verteilnetze, Energieversorgungsunternehmen oder Rechenzentren. Kenntnisse des Produktportfolios von Hitachi Energy sind wünschenswert. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Management komplexer Kundenbeziehungen sowie in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Vertriebsstrategien. Versiert im erfogreichen Manövrieren in den Strukturen eines Grosskonzerns und Marktführers Fundierte Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung und Führung von komplexen Ausschreibungen Fähigkeit, operativ detailnah zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig auf Top‑Management‑Ebene sicher aufzutreten Sehr gute Kenntnisse gängiger Sales‑, CRM‑ und Office‑Tools Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil 
• Was wir bieten Schlüsselrolle bei einem zentralen Akteur der Schweizer Energieinfrastruktur Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum mit direktem Einfluss auf Geschäftsbeziehung und Markterfolg Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Expertinnen und Experten sowie Entscheidungsträgern innerhalb von Hitachi Energy Attraktive Entwicklungs‑ und Karrieremöglichkeiten in einem global führenden Technologieunternehmen Beitrag zu einer sicheren, nachhaltigen und zukunftsfähigen Energieversorgung

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Come Senior Key Account Manager, si assume la responsabilità di un cliente strategicamente importante nel campo dell'infrastruttura energetica svizzera. Essi operano in un ambiente stimolante e tecnicamente sagomato e lavorano a stretto contatto con aree specialistiche interne per sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili e partnership a lungo termine. Il focus di questo ruolo è sul supporto operativo e strategico del cliente, compresa la gestione attiva delle offerte e dei processi teneri. Mansioni - Responsabilità totale per un account strategico nel campo dell'infrastruttura di rete (assunzione di ordini, redditività, soddisfazione del cliente) - Stabilimento e manutenzione di relazioni a lungo termine e resilienti con le parti interessate dei clienti pertinenti a tutti i livelli gerarchici, compresi i livelli C - Garantire una prestazione professionale costante di Hitachi Energy contro un giocatore centrale dell'approvvigionamento energetico svizzero - Cooperazione attiva e gestione professionale delle offerte locali (Tenders) – dalla strategia di gara alla fase di negoziazione alla conclusione del contratto - Sviluppo e realizzazione di una strategia di conto e crescita specifica per il cliente (posizione di mercato, pipeline, previsione, ambiente competitivo) - Chiudere la cooperazione con le unità e le funzioni aziendali interne (vendita, ingegneria, project management, servizio ecc.) per una soluzione ottimale e offrire design - Applicazione e sviluppo di processi e strumenti standardizzati di vendita e CRM (ad esempio Salesforce, Account Plans, KPI)
• Requisiti - Studi universitari completi in ingegneria o qualifiche comparabili - Ulteriori competenze di gestione auspicabili - Esperienza a lungo termine nella gestione dei conti chiave o nella distribuzione di soluzioni tecniche complesse, idealmente nei settori della generazione di energia, delle reti di trasmissione e distribuzione, delle società di approvvigionamento energetico o dei data center - La conoscenza del portafoglio prodotti di Hitachi Energy è auspicabile - comprovata esperienza nella gestione di complesse relazioni con i clienti e nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di vendita - Nella manovra esplorativa delle strutture di un grande gruppo e leader di mercato - Trovata esperienza nel trattamento e nella gestione di avvisi complessi - Capacità di lavorare in modo operativo dettagliato e di eseguire in modo sicuro al livello di gestione superiore - Ottima conoscenza delle vendite popolari, CRM e strumenti di ufficio - competenze linguistiche tedesche in parola e scrittura; conoscenza inglese fluente; conoscenza francese del vantaggio Cosa? - ruolo chiave in un player centrale nell'infrastruttura energetica svizzera - Spazio di design elevato con influenza diretta sul rapporto di lavoro e sul successo del mercato - Una stretta collaborazione con esperti e decisori esperti all'interno di Hitachi Energy - Opportunità di sviluppo e di carriera interessanti in una società tecnologica leader a livello globale - Contributo a un approvvigionamento energetico sicuro, sostenibile e sostenibile Contatto
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione As a Senior Key Account Manager, you take responsibility for a strategically important customer in the field of Swiss energy infrastructure. They operate in a challenging, technically shaped environment and work closely with internal specialist areas to develop sustainable solutions and long-term partnerships. The focus of this role is on the customer's operational and strategic support, including the active management of tenders and tender processes. Mansioni - Total responsibility for a strategic key account in the field of network infrastructure (order intake, profitability, customer satisfaction) - Establishment and maintenance of long-term, resilient relationships with relevant customer stakeholders at all hierarchical levels including C levels - Ensuring a consistent, professional performance by Hitachi Energy against a central player of the Swiss energy supply - Active cooperation and professional management of local tenders (Tenders) – from the tender strategy to the negotiation phase to the conclusion of the contract - Development and implementation of a customer-specific account and growth strategy (market positioning, pipeline, forecast, competitive environment) - Close cooperation with internal business units and functions (sales, engineering, project management, service etc.) for optimal solution and offer design - Application and development of standardized sales and CRM processes and tools (e.g. Salesforce, Account Plans, KPIs)
• Requisiti - Complete university studies in engineering or comparable qualifications - Additional management skills desirable - Long-term experience in key account management or the distribution of complex technical solutions, ideally in the fields of energy generation, transmission and distribution networks, energy supply companies or data centers - Knowledge of Hitachi Energy's product portfolio is desirable - proven experience in the management of complex customer relationships and in the development and implementation of sales strategies - In the exploratory manoeuvring in the structures of a large group and market leader - Found experience in the processing and management of complex alerts - Ability to work operationally detailed and to perform safely at top management level - Very good knowledge of popular sales, CRM and office tools - German language skills in word and writing; flowing English knowledge; French knowledge of advantage
• Cosa offriamo - Key role in a central player in the Swiss energy infrastructure - High design space with direct influence on business relationship and market success - Close cooperation with experienced experts and decision-makers within Hitachi Energy - Attractive development and career opportunities in a globally leading technology company - Contribution to a secure, sustainable and sustainable energy supply Contatto
